items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola Wild
items.detail: Nuka-Cola Collectron Station produces it, or find it at Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Collect Toilet Paper
items.detail: Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron produces it, or check the maintenance building at Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Craft any Flair at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Craft at Tinker's Workbench under Souvenirs category with a learned plan.

items.title: Kill a Cryptid
items.detail: Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go spawns up to three Snallygasters reliably.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with any Energy Weapon
items.detail: Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center has low-level robots.

items.title: Mod a Weapon
items.detail: Apply any mod or weapon skin at a weapons workbench.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Cork
items.detail: Craft Bulk Cork at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it.

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any turret or trap in Defense menu; Punji Board costs only 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Harvest at Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs, or plant Slipper Cactus in your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Giant Teapot or Tanagra Town cave near the top of the giant tree have reliable spawns.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as uninvited guest at Head Hunt event in final Slasher stage at Highway Town.

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Point Pleasant has up to 34 Cultists; target the head for faster kills.

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Degrade a Protest Sign from Grafton with one hit, then repair with Wood at a workbench.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap crystal liquor decanters at any workbench; Clancy Manor has decanters on tables.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint under encumbrance limit on open ground; running from Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center north toward Morgantown works well.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn Gold Star on three separate days during the week by completing six daily challenges each day.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All public events spawn with mutations and award special mutated rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Earn experience points at double rate across all activities.

events.name: World Pets Update
events.description: Patch 72 releases and Season 27 begins with new world pet companion system.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event runs alongside doubled mutation effects on creatures and events.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Special holiday-themed Scorched creatures appear with festive rewards and waterlogged gifts.
